name: Anthony Tomasi
source:
Anthony "The Hammer" Tomasi is a small-time criminal with a posse: The Hammer Gang. Anthony was once an up-and-coming soldier in the mob, but when young [url=/c176673]Vincenzo Bellarosa[/url] took over the Bellarosa family business, Anthony didn't move up and wasn't too pleased about it. Vincenzo wasn't too concerned and promptly gave Anthony his walking papers… after a punishing beating. Anthony avoids getting in Bellarosa's way and stays alive, but there is hatred brewing.

[Edited from in-game description]
